decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Sound insulation scheme (between floors)</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Sound insulation shall be installed between the commercial premises on the ground floor and the residential premises on the first floor. The Environmental Protection Section recommends that, within habitable rooms with windows closed, internal noise levels in residential units shall not exceed 35dB LAeq during the day and 30 dB LAeq at night. The applicant shall:</span></p><ol style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-inline-start:48px;"><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;" role="presentation"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to commencement the applicant shall submit a detailed sound insulation scheme to the Local Planning Authority for approval.</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" role="presentation"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to occupation of the residential units, a sound insulation test must be conducted to verify compliance with the required noise levels, and the results submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.</span></p></li></ol><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d0c655f5-7fff-ef9a-212f-cba98c747fd1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In the interests of the amenities of future occupiers.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Sound insulation scheme (external)</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The applicant shall ensure that adequate noise control measures are incorporated into the proposed residential development, hereby approved, which shall effectively mitigate the potential impact of noise and/or nuisance arising from the existing licensed premises in the vicinity of the development.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The approved noise control measures shall be designed such that future occupants of the residential development shall have no justifiable grounds to formally complain about nuisance. The applicant shall:</span></p><ol style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-inline-start:48px;"><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;" role="presentation"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to installation, submit details of a scheme of sound insulation to the Local Planning Authority for approval.</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" role="presentation"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to occupation of the residential units, a sound test shall be carried out to show that the required noise levels from the approved scheme have been met, and the results submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing. The sound insulation scheme as approved and subsequently tested shall be implemented prior to occupation of any of the residential units.</span></p></li></ol><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-49b9ea35-7fff-a892-aead-46802175f5b9"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure the amenities of existing and future occupiers are protected.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Further noise survey and review of acoustic specification</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The applicant shall ensure that adequate noise control measures are incorporated into the proposed residential development, which shall effectively mitigate the potential impact of noise and/or nuisance arising from the existing licensed premises in the vicinity of the development. The approved noise control measures shall be designed such that future occupants of the residential development shall </span>have no justifiable grounds to formally complain about nuisance. The applicant shall:</p><ol style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-inline-start:48px;"><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;" role="presentation"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to commencement, submit an updated Facade Noise Impact Assessment for approval by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall provide details of a noise survey undertaken at the facade of 117-121 Curtain Road during an external music event occurring within the Strongroom courtyard. The survey results will be used to determine the appropriate acoustic performance of wall linings and glazing for the approved residential units.&nbsp;</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;" role="presentation"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to installation, details of the scheme of sound insulation that shall be submitted for approval by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p></li><li dir="ltr" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;" aria-level="1"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the occupation of the residential unit, a test shall be carried out to show that the required noise levels have been met, and the results submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.</span></p></li></ol><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-26b94ff6-7fff-09f8-23bd-ebe27295bf2f"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In the interests of the amenities of the prospective occupiers of the flats, and taking into account the Agent of Change policy.</span></p>
